senses.gloss: पुष्कर- + अक्ष पुष्कर- + अक्ष, adj. lotus-eyed.
पुष्प- + आगम पुष्प- + आगम, m. spring, Ṛt. 6, 34.
पुष्प- + आसार पुष्प- + आसार, m. a shower of flowers, Megh. 44.
पुष्प- + शर पुष्प- + शर, m. Kāma.
पुष्प- + इषु पुष्प- + इषु, m. the god of love.
पुष्पेषु पुष्पेषु, i. e. पुष्प-इषु, m. Kāma, the god of love (properly, Having flowers for arrows.)
पुष्प- + करण्डक पुष्प- + करण्डक, n. the name of a garden, Mṛcch. 148, 19.
कुसुम-, पुष्प- + चाप कुसुम-, पुष्प- + चाप, m. a name of the god of love, Ragh. 9, 33; Kathās. 14, 29.
पुष्कर- + चूड पुष्कर- + चूड, m. the name of one of the four elephants who are supposed to support the world, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 39.
पुष्प- + दंष्ट्र पुष्प- + दंष्ट्र, m. the name of a demon.

पुष्प- + दन्त पुष्प- + दन्त,
 I. m. 1. the name of a Gandharva and other beings. 2. du. the sun and the moon, Śatr. 14, 225.
 II. f. ती, the name of a female Rākṣasa.
 III. n. the name of a temple.
पुष्प-दामन् पुष्प-दामन्, n. a garland, Śṛṅgārat. 10.
पुष्प- + धनुस् पुष्प- + धनुस्, m. a name of the god of love, Śiś. 9, 41.
पुष्प- + पत्रिन् पुष्प- + पत्रिन्, adj. having flowers for arrows, Kumāras. 4, 29.
पुष्प- + पाण्डु पुष्प- + पाण्डु, m. a kind of snake.

पुष् पुष्, ii. 9, Par.
 1. To nourish, MBh. 3, 13639.
 2. To cherish, Pañc. 238, 7.
 3. To manage, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.
 4. To augment, Rājat. 5, 159.
 --i. 4, Par.
 1. To thrive, to prosper, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.
 2. To enjoy, Ragh. 18, 32.
 3. To possess, Ragh. 16, 58.
 4. To exhibit, Man. 9, 37.
 5. To [] unfold, Śāk. d. 18.
 6. To support, to maintain, Rām. 4, 61, 24.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. पुष्ट,
 1. Nourished.
 2. Well-fed, strong, Chr. 4, 18.
 3. Eminent, Man. 4, 231.
 4. Loud, Hariv. 14063.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. To cause to be nourished, Śāk. 107, 7.
 --Caus. or i. 10, Par.
 1. To nourish, Lass. 99, 3 = Rigv. v. 9, 7. To cherish, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1890.
 --Cf.
 2. व्युष्.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतिपुष्ट, Very strong, Pañc. iii. d. 8.
 --Comp.
 न-, adj. rather insignificant, paltry, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 14.
 --With परि परि, परिपुष्ट,
 1. Cherished.
 2. Abounding in.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to be cherished or managed, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.
 2. To cherish, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2602.
 --With प्र प्र, To nourish, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 10.
 --With वि वि, विपुष्ट, Ill-fed, low, Pañc. i. d. 313 (rather पुष्ट, with वि).
 --With सम् सम्, ii. 9, To increase, Bhartṛ. 2, 13.
पुस् पुस्, see व्युष्.

† पूष् पूष्, i. 1, Par. To nourish.
 --Cf. पुष्.
पुष पुष् + अ, in ग्रह-, m. The sun (nourishing the planets by its light). f. षा, The name of a plant.

पुष्कर पुष्कर (probably पुष्-कृ + अ).
 I. n.
 1. Water.
 2. The sky, heaven, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1770.
 3. The blue lotus flower, MBh. 1, 4704.
 4. The tip of an elephant's trunk, Pañc. 80, 8.
 5. The skin of a drum, Ragh. 17, 11.
 6. A drug, Costus speciosus.
 7. The name of a celebrated place of pilgrimage.
 8. The blade of a sword.
 9. The sheath of a sword.
 10. (also m.), One of the seven great Dvīpas, or divisions of the world.
 11. An arrow.
 12. The art or science of dancing.
 13. War, battle.
 14. Intoxication.
 15. A cage.
 16. A part.
 II. [] m.
 1. A pond or lake.
 2. A drum, a kettle-drum, Megh. 67.
 3. One of the principal clouds, that which occasions dearth.
 4. The Indian crane.
 5. A sort of snake.
 6. A proper name.
 --Comp.
पुष्कराय पुष्कराय, a denomin. derived from पुष्कर with य, Ātm. To represent a drum, Daśarūp. 1.
पुष्करावती पुष्करावती, i. e. पुष्कर + वन्त् + ई, f. The name of a town.
पुष्करावर्तक पुष्करावर्तक, i. e. पुष्कर-आवर्त + क, m. A certain kind of cloud, Megh. 6.

पुष्करिन् पुष्करिन्, i. e. पुष्कर + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी, Abounding in lotus flowers, Rām. 3, 76, 5.
 II. m. An elephant.
 III. f. इणी, A pool where the lotus does or may grow, Arj. 4, 50.

पुष्कल पुष्कल (= पुष्कर, with ल् for र्),
 I. adj., f. ला.
 1. Excellent, Man. 8, 81; best.
 2. Good, salutary.
 3. Much, Rām. 1, 71, 2 Gorr.; many, Bhag. 11, 21; with following न, More than, Man. 3, 129.
 4. Complete.
 5. Loud, MBh. 7, 578.
 II. m. A kind of drum, MBh. 6, 1631.
 III. n.
 1. A certain measure.
 2. Alms to the extent of four mouthfuls of food.
 3. The name of a holy place.
 4. A proper name.
 --Comp.

पुष्कलक पुष्कल + क, m.
 1. The musk deer.
 2. A pin, a bolt.
 3. A Bauddha mendicant.
पुष्कलावती पुष्कलावती, = पुष्करावती.

पुष्टि पुष्टि, i. e. पुष् + ति, f.
 1. Thriving, increase, Pañc. 215, 2.
 2. Vegetation, Man. 9, 37.
 3. Prosperity, Pañc. i. d. 246.
 4. Nourishment, [] Man. 2, 32.
 5. One of the divine mothers.
पुष्टिका पुष्टि + का, f. An oyster.

पुष्टिद पुष्टि + द,
 I. adj. Yielding prosperity, Hariv. 833.
 II. m. A class of Manes, Mārk. P. 96, 45.
 III. f. दा, The name of a plant, Physalis flexuosa Lin.

पुष्प् पुष्प् (rather an anomal. denomin. derived from पुष्प), i. 4, Par. To flower, to blossom, Hariv. 12799 (also i. 1, Mālatīm. 153, 5; Hariv. 7874).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. पुष्पित (rather पुष्प + इत), Flowered, in flower. f. ता, A woman during menstruation.
 --Comp.

पुष्प पुष् + प,
 I. n.
 1. A flower, Nal. 13, 3.
 2. The menses, Mārk. P. 51, 42.
 3. The vehicle or car of Kuvera.
 4. A disease of the eyes, albugo.
 5. A topaz, Rām. 2, 94, 6 (cf. पुष्प-राग).
 II. m. A proper name.
 III. f. पा, The capital of Karṇa.
 --Comp.

पुष्पक पुष्प + क,
 I. m. A kind of snake, Suśr. 2, 265, 20.
 II. n.
 1. The chariot of Kuvera, Rām. 3, 36, 15.
 2. A bracelet of diamonds or jewels.
 3. A cup or vessel of iron.
 4. Green vitriol.
पुष्पध पुष्प-ध, m. The offspring of an outcaste Brāhmaṇa, Man. 10, 21.
पुष्पंधय पुष्पंधय, i. e. पुष्प + म्-धे + अ, m. A bee.
पुष्पमय पुष्पमय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of flowers, Rām. 5, 5, 17.
पुष्पलिह् पुष्प-लिह्, m. A bee.
पुष्पवत् पुष्प + वत्, adv. Like a flower or flowers, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1876.

पुष्पवन्त् पुष्प + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Having flowers, MBh. 6, 529.
 II. m.
 1. A proper name.
 2. du. The sun and the moon.
 III. f. वती.
 1. A woman during menstruation.
 2. A proper name.
पुष्पाकर पुष्पाकर, i. e. पुष्प-आकर, adj. Abounding in flowers, Vikr. d. 9 (with मास, i. e. Spring).
पुष्पिन् पुष्पिन्, i. e. पुष्प + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Bearing flowers, blossoming, Man. 1, 47.

पुष्य पुष् + य, m.
 1. The eighth lunar asterism.
 2. The name of a month, Dec.--Jan.
 3. The fourth age, Kaliyuga.

† पुस्त् पुस्त्, i. 10, Par.
 I. To bind.
 II. (also बुस्त् बुस्त्), i. 10, Par.
 1. To respect.
 2. To disregard.

पुस्त पुस्त,
 I. m. and n. A book.
 II. n. Working in clay, modelling, Kathās. 34, 172.
पुस्तक पुस्त + क, m. and n. A book, a manuscript, Pañc. 127, 2.
पुस्तमय पुस्त + मय, adj., f. यी, Wrought in clay, modelled, Suśr. 1, 29, 9.

पूषन् पूषन्, i. e. पुष् + अन्, m.
 1. [] The name of a vedic deity.
 2. One of the Ādityas, MBh. 1, 2523.
 3. The sun, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 461.
पुष्पित-पलाश- + प्रतिम पुष्पित-पलाश- + प्रतिम, adj. Resembling a Butea frondosa full of flowers, Pañc. 91, 7.
पुष्प- + भङ्ग पुष्प- + भङ्ग, m. treading on flowers, Nal. 25, 7 (Sch.).
पूषभासा पूषभासा, i. e. पूषन्-, f. The capital of Indra.
पुष्प- + मास् पुष्प- + मास्, m. spring (the season), Rām. 3, 79, 16.
पुष्प- + मास पुष्प- + मास, m. spring (the season), Rām. 3, 79, 39.
पुष्प- + रथ पुष्प- + रथ, or पुष्य-, m. a carriage for pleasure, Rām. 2, 26, 15 (पुष्प-).
पुष्प- + राग पुष्प- + राग, m. a topaz, Ragh. 18, 31.
पुष्प- + लाव पुष्प- + लाव, 1. m. a garland-maker, a flower-seller. 2. f. वी, a female flower-gatherer, Megh. 27.
पुष्प-वाटी पुष्प-वाटी, f. a flower-garden, Pañc. 221, 10 (erroneously पुष्य-).
पुष्प-वेणी पुष्प-वेणी, f. 1. a chaplet, Rām. 3, 68, 41. 2. the name of a river.
पुष्कर- + स्थपति पुष्कर- + स्थपति, m. a name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1207 (erroneously written पुस्कर-).

पुष्प- + हास पुष्प- + हास, m. 1. a flowergarden (?), Hariv. 12395.
 2. a name of Viṣṇu. 3. a proper name.
